items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-10-07
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Book' in a list of band members ('Book, cool, old, ripped...'), but the interviewee does not respond with any personal interaction or relationship details regarding 'Book'.

ctx.x: And who was in that band?

Who? Shoo. How many of them? Eleven men at that time. They touched that time. Book, cool, old, ripped. Buck, what all they did. Bucku? I had a gun. I had a gun. Henry Glass. Henry Glass. Henry Glass played what? The air or bass? Uh... Bass drum.
And who was that? Buck, you said?
